text:
dana: Quick follow-up from the security segment 1: SOC2/ISO notes + quick action list. Pasting questions we promised to answer.
omar: First Q: for customer evidence exports, can the export include a signed attestation and human-readable chain-of-custody? Auditors asked for signature + who/why fields.
linh: Yes. Plan: signed manifest + fields: requested_by, request_ticket, purpose, timestamp, signature_alg, signature. We'll append manifest.json next to the bundle.
tara: For Dedicated customers, will retention be configurable per contract? Some customers need 7+ years.
omar: Product answer: default 1y hot + 4y cold; enterprise contracts can request extended archive up to 10y. Need legal approval for public docs.
dana: Action: publish retention tiers in public FAQ once legal signs off.
compliance-bot: Note: evidence-exporter v2.1 deployed by linh at 2260045200.
linh: KMS question: do we expose rotation history and key usage logs to customers?
tara: We return rotation timestamps and principal ids for cloud KMS. For BYOK/HSM pilots, we'll include vendor attestation files and a rotation_event log in the bundle.
omar: VPC flow logs: customers want a sample policy to ship flow logs into their SIEM with least privilege. Can we provide a template?
linh: I'll add an example IAM role, flow log config, and sample ingress filter to the docs. CLI sample: ```redwood infra export-flow --vpc vpc-0a1b2c --dest s3://cust-logs/ --role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/RedwoodExportRole```
dana: Can the web console show who downloaded a bundle and when? That's an auditor ask.
tara: Backend will emit download events to the audit index and surface a provenance UI. UX backlog ticket incoming.
omar: Owners and due dates so we can close:
- Publish retention tiers + legal review (owner: tara, due: 2026-04-04)
- Implement signed manifest + request fields (owner: linh, due: 2026-04-10)
- BYOK/HSM pilot scope + attestation format (owner: omar, due: 2026-06-01)
- Flow log export samples + IAM templates (owner: linh, due: 2026-03-29)
- Bundle provenance UI card (owner: tara, due: 2026-04-12)
linh: I'll post the doc drafts in #eng-security once ready. Tag me for review.
dana: Great, thanks everyone. Ping here if anything slips.
compliance-bot: Reminder: create ticket 'evidence-provenance' and link here.
